attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012228680 (CC0): the red brick fronts with their yellow-brick colossal lisenen and frieze, the bluestone string courses, the round-arched blind tympana with keystones over the first-floor windows, the dentil cornice and middle pediment, the round-arched entrance with its stone balustrade above, and the side dormer with its pediment and volutes, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0) and the municipal monument register (CC0). No pixels or meshes imported.
